title: PAIR: Prefix-Aware Internal Reward Model for Multi-Turn Agent Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.17877v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A significant hurdle for current LLMs is the execution of complex, multi-stage tasks. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been emerging as a leading choice, but its reliance on sparse outcome rewards severely limits credit assignment across intermediate steps. Existing remedies such as running full rollouts to assign step-level advantages, calling external LLM judges at each step, or computing intrinsic rewards that require ground-truth answers at every evaluation introduce significant costs or practical constraints. We hypothesize that internal correctness probing over LLM hidden states can be repurposed as a step-level reward signal, potentially addressing all of these limitations at once. translated_title: PAIR：面向多轮智能体优化的前缀感知内部奖励模型
translated_abstract: 当前大语言模型面临的一个重大障碍是执行复杂的多阶段任务。群体相对策略优化（GRPO）正日益成为主流选择，但其对稀疏结果奖励的依赖严重限制了跨中间步骤的信用分配。现有补救措施，如运行完整 rollout 来分配步骤级优势、在每一步调用外部 LLM 评判器，或计算需要在每次评估中使用真实答案的内在奖励，都会带来高昂成本或实际限制。我们假设对 LLM 隐藏状态进行的内部正确性探测可以被重新用作步骤级奖励信号，从而有可能同时解决上述所有限制。然而，现有探测研究都假设输入是干净的，我们首先证明这一假设在多步设定下会失效：隐藏状态探测器在前缀污染下性能严重退化，与（可能被污染的）……
tldr: 该论文提出前缀感知的内部奖励模型 PAIR，通过修正前缀污染导致的 LLM 隐藏状态探测退化，为多轮智能体任务的 GRPO 训练提供无需外部评判器和真实答案的步骤级内部奖励信号。
en_tdlr: PAIR proposes a prefix-aware internal reward model that corrects hidden-state probe degradation under prefix contamination, enabling step-level internal rewards for GRPO-based multi-turn agent optimization without external LLM judges or ground-truth answers.
